setModelTip: The model that generates the suggestions. Auto uses the chat's model inside the turn; an explicit language or model uses a separate call.
modelUnavailable: No model list available in this install

meta.title: Nextsteps - Dev
meta.description: Suggested next-step prompts under every finished agent turn — one click sends the followup.

intro: Suggested next-step prompts under every finished agent turn — one click sends the followup.
setLanguageTip: Followups are generated in this language. Auto follows the conversation; an explicit language uses a separate call.
setMaxTip: How many suggested prompts the model should produce (1-6).
setHeaderTip: The small “Suggested followups” label above the cards.
setConfirmSendTip: The first click arms the send and the second confirms; it also applies to new conversation.
setStylesTip: The angles the suggestions should cover. The generator varies the prompts across the selected styles. At least one style stays selected.
setGenModeTip: Auto suggests the followups when the turn ends; on demand waits for your button.
setBudgetTip: How long the generator may run before the request is given up (5000-120000 ms).
setMaxCharsTip: The maximum number of characters of one suggestion (60-600).
favoriteDuplicate: A favourite with this text already exists.
copyFailed: The suggestion could not be copied.
srCopied: The suggestion was copied to the clipboard.
srDiscarded: The suggestion was discarded. Use Undo to bring it back.
srFavorited: The suggestion was saved as a favourite.
srFavoritesCopied: {n} favourites were copied to the clipboard.
srSendConfirm: The send is armed; click again to confirm.
srInserted: The suggestion was placed in the composer draft.
favoritesExportFailed: The favourites could not be exported.
favoritesImportFailed: The file could not be imported.
settingsUnavailable: Opening the settings is not available here.
newChatConfirm: Start a new conversation with this suggestion?
newChatUnavailable: Starting a new conversation is not available here.
insertDraftUnavailable: Placing the suggestion in the composer is not available here.
upToDate: You are on the latest version
installedMsg: Version {v} was installed. Restart the dsh to use it.
heldBackMsg: Version {v} was installed instead of {asked} — pnpm holds back a release that is too recent.
localDev: Local development copy — update with git pull.
unsupportedVersion: That release is not a version this plugin can install
updatePrecheck: The version could not be verified on the npm registry.
updateNoManager: No plugin installer is available in this host.
setRetentionTip: Automatically delete stored suggestions older than this many days. 0 turns it off (0-365).
setTranscriptScopeTip: How much of the turn the generator sees. Minimal sends only the last user and assistant messages.
warnInjection: This suggestion looks like a prompt-injection attempt
warnSecrets: This suggestion looks like it contains a credential or secret
srSecretsWarning: A suggestion looks like it contains a credential or secret.
srPrivateOn: This conversation is private; suggestions stay in memory only.
srPrivateOff: This conversation is no longer private.
privatePurgeFailed: The stored suggestions of this conversation could not be deleted; check the storage.
setCardActionsTip: Pick which actions each card shows and in which order. Uncheck to hide one; uncheck all to hide every action.
cardActionsHiddenAll: No actions are shown on the cards.
generationTimeoutTip: The generator ran out of time — try again, or raise the latency budget in the settings.
